gen-gf-goldman-gf-hammersmith-one: Commanding and wide-set, Goldman stretches its round forms out like open parentheses. Hammersmith One keeps its capitals barely taller than the lowercase, with rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord, and that softness is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-inder: Goldman spreads its bold, widely set letters with generous clearance, its lowercase running big against the capitals. Inder follows in sans-serif, with little height difference between cases.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-jaldi: Jaldi sets its brushed letters close together, with a lowercase pushed well above the usual height and a visibly gaping c. Goldman then leads above it, bold and widely spaced, so the two feel clearly different.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Round forms that read like open parentheses, set wide with generous clearance, give Goldman its commanding look at the top. Kdam Thmor Pro fills the line with its bowls.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-krona-one: Goldman's round forms read like open parentheses, widely set and generously cleared, with a big lowercase against its capitals. Krona One answers underneath with loosely spaced sans letters, its lowercase carrying the stature of cast iron capitals.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-magra: Goldman's widely set, parenthesis-round letters mark it out at once. Goldman handles the bold, commanding statement, while Magra gives a big-bodied feel to every lowercase word in a plain sans manner.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-major-mono-display: Goldman is wide-set and round. It commands with bold letters, while Major Mono Display sets precise monospace forms with a tube-like stroke resembling neon glass.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-martian-mono: Structured and technical, Martian Mono is the monospace partner here. Its far-apart, code-style letters and generous curve openings would read loose and steady in long text, against Goldman's bold, commanding headings.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-matemasie: Matemasie opens with broad gaps between glyphs and small entry points into its round letters, drawn as uninterrupted monoline strokes. Goldman's bold, commanding shapes make that sans feel even lighter.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-menbere: Goldman lays down widely set, bold letters with generous clearance and round forms like open parentheses. And Menbere, a plain sans, stacks its lowercase tall like rolled cord.
